div.b: 8 NestJS Feature Modules & Internal Mock Gateway
div.br:
• AuthModule (JWT 15m/7d, Bcryptjs 10) • ProductsModule (Menu, Toppings, Check Kho)
• OrdersModule (State Machine) • PromotionsModule • ReviewsModule
• PaymentModule (Idempotency-Key, OCC, mbbank-sync/-check/-invalidate, MockGatewayService & /api/mock-gateway/charge)
• StaffModule (Kanban FIFO, Order Recipes) • AdminModule (Kho, Công thức, NCC, Báo cáo)

• DB Docker (npm run docker:up → :5432) + Host Node (npm run dev:backend :3001, dev:frontend :3000)
• Ở localhost, lib/api.ts gọi trực tiếp http://127.0.0.1:3001/api; hoặc chạy trọn bộ qua npm run docker:all (build local)
• Test Mobile QR qua scripts/tunnel.js (cloudflared :443 → :3000) hoặc https-proxy.js (:3443 → :3000 & :3001)

• Runner cô lập (ubuntu-latest) + service postgres:16-alpine tạm thời (dữ liệu seed test) cho ci.yml
• ci.yml: eslint / tsc --noEmit → prisma migrate deploy → seed → Jest Unit & test:e2e → nest & next build
• cd.yml: Quality Gate (lint, Unit, build) → build & push ghcr.io (brewlite-web, brewlite-api) → Hook / Compose Smoke Test

«boundary» Environment 3: Production (Isolated Boundaries / PaaS Option)
• Chỉ mở HTTPS :443 (TLS 1.3) qua Edge Proxy / Cloudflare tới brewlite_frontend :3000 (hoặc Vercel + Render render.yaml)
• Chặn công khai port 3001 & 5432 khi lên Prod (Firewall / Override compose); giao tiếp nội bộ qua brewlite_network
